none: PAS NLM-4C7F36: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Coin. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), probably a Gloria exercitus issue of 330-335, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Bust right. Reverse description: Two soldiers with probably two standards between them. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA EXERCITVS]. Diameter: 14.7mm, Weight: 1.38gms, die axis: probably 12
